trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the fluke center with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and significant vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (3-10 pixels) alternating with shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the median notch transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-intensity white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface encrustation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white clusters at both fluke tips; irregular trailing edge profile with a distinct small notch on the outer third of the left lobe.
